label: Calibrated projection
scope: Sum of dominant-work measurements and proxies; no complete Bolt opening, verification, or Flock/Bolt integration
model: A = row evaluation + independent random column fold + 2 sumchecks + inner_message_proxy + inner_syndrome_proxy; non-amortized adds d(d-1) product scans of length 8k
amortization: Amortized limit omits sparse-matrix proof allocation. Finite batches require adding the allocated proof cost and batching work.
omitted: Sparse-relation/batching basis preparation; outer Merkle extraction/serialization; full Fiat-Shamir integration; Mulperm witness/setup and other work; binary-witness adaptation; composed-security retuning
proxy_scope: Separate complete Ligerito proximity runs on extension-field tables of lengths k and k/8 include their own encoding/commitment. They are not the constrained/virtual or batched inner RS proofs in Bolt.
